title: The Widow’s Oil
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the big, brave heart that does the hard thing he is asked, and tonight the widow gathers jar after jar on the prophet’s word: Beau knocks on door after door to borrow chairs until everyone has a seat.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because doing what you are asked, even when it feels hard, takes a brave heart. In Beau’s world today: the family is having the neighbors over, and there are not enough chairs. Dad says, “Go knock on doors and ask to borrow chairs. Ask for lots!” Beau feels shy, but he knocks anyway, door after door. Soon the yard is full of chairs, and everyone has a seat. Just like the widow gathering empty jars, Beau learned that when you obey, there is room for a blessing.
